title: PokeUtilities
description: Highlights wild shinies and legendaries in Cobblemon, with a live catch-rate overlay tied to the ball in your hand.
body:
# PokeUtilities

Client-side quality-of-life mod for [Cobblemon](https://cobblemon.com) on Fabric. ESP-style highlights for shinies and legendaries, plus a live overlay that shows species, level, HP, IVs, and **catch-rate prediction** based on the ball in your hand.

> **Client-side only.** No server install required. Sends only the same packets the vanilla Cobblemon client would.

---

## Features (free)

### PokeFinder
- Highlight wild **shiny** Pokémon
- Highlight wild **legendary** Pokémon
- **Species filter** — highlight specific species by name (multi-select with autocomplete from the Cobblemon dex)
- Configurable colors

### Overlay
- Species, level, HP for the Pokémon you're looking at or fighting
- Numeric IVs
- **Live catch-rate prediction** — updates as you switch balls in hand

### Config
- Press `U` in-game, or open via ModMenu

---

## Premium

Premium build adds:

- **World-space tracers** — camera-to-target lines for highlighted Pokémon
- **Pokédex helper** — orange line for species you've never encountered, dim gray for seen-but-not-caught
- **Smart filters** — IV thresholds (count of perfect IVs, total IV sum), level threshold, hidden-ability, specific abilities / natures / genders lists
- **Extended dossier** — gender, ability (with hidden marker), nature (with mint flag), held item, caught ball, tera type, friendship
- **Type-effectiveness HUD** — your moves' multipliers vs. the opposing Pokémon during battle
- **Battle move advisor** — picks the strongest move each turn using a Showdown-trained PPO neural net plus an AlphaZero-style game-tree search with a Nash solver. Three modes: PPO-only (fast), search-only (deeper), and PPO+search (search guided by the network's value estimates)
- **Auto-fish** — vanilla rods + Cobblemon PokéRods, recasts and reels in bites
- **Auto-leave fishing battles** — flees wild fishing encounters with a species whitelist for the ones you want to keep
- **Auto-battle** — picks first usable move (or first alive party switch) each turn
- **Force-forfeit keybind** — flee on demand from any wild battle

Premium ships via Ko-fi: <https://ko-fi.com/furix>

Funds development of both builds. Free build keeps getting bug fixes and MC version bumps.

---

## Requirements

| Mod | Version |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | `1.21.1` |
| Fabric Loader | `>= 0.16.0` |
| Fabric API | latest for `1.21.1` |
| Fabric Language Kotlin | `>= 1.13.0` |
| [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) | `>= 1.7.3, < 1.8.0` |
| [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) | `>= 3.6.1` |
| [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) | `>= 11.0.3` |

## Install

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.1
2. Drop required mods (above) into `mods/`
3. Drop `pokeutilities-1.0.0.jar` into the same `mods/`
4. Launch

> Premium ships as a **separate, standalone jar** distributed via Ko-fi. It replaces the free jar (delete the free one first); the two cannot run together.

## FAQ

**Why two builds?** Free covers the core QoL — highlights, overlay, catch-rate prediction. Premium is a separate, standalone jar (not an add-on) that includes everything free has plus the heavier stuff (tracers, smart filters, auto-actions, battle-move advisor). Ko-fi funds new development on the premium branch and bug-fix / version-bump work on the free one.

**Will free features get gated later?** No. **Free build will not have features removed or paywalled retroactively.** Anything currently in the free build stays in the free build.

**Can I run free and premium together?** No — they share the same Fabric mod id. Premium replaces free at install time: delete the free jar, drop in the premium jar.

**Anti-cheat / fair play?** Mod only reads client-visible state and renders overlays.

**Network / telemetry?** None. The mod opens no sockets; the only outbound action is launching your default browser when you click the Ko-fi link.
